description.value: The Enchanted Forest is a long-running family attraction set in an old-growth forest 32 km west of Revelstoke on the Trans-Canada Highway, featuring over 350 handcrafted fairy tale figurines, BC's tallest treehouse, and a castle with dungeons. A 2 km self-guided wildland interpretive nature walk winds through the lush BC forest, and in autumn visitors can watch Kokanee, Sockeye, Spring, and Cohoe salmon spawning from an on-site bridge. The sister attraction SkyTrek Adventure Park is located immediately adjacent on Highway 1.
